verdict.rationale: Channel3's own docs describe an agentic search mode in which a built-in LLM plans the user's request: it extracts filters and splits the query into sub-searches. That is narrow, product-native delegation of search tasks rather than a general in-product assistant. The MCP server and CLI let external agents call the product, so they are not a built-in assistant and are not credited. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant that accepts delegated tasks beyond search, multi-step task execution, documentation of the assistant UX, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agentic mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Toggle to agentic mode, and an LLM plans the search: it extracts deterministic filters, may split the request into OR/AND sub-searches
